'''November 2000 Madrid tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Generacion X, Madrid, Spain on 11 November 2000. [[Luis Alvarez]] won it. It is known from Angel San Jose's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1460">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-15-ithor-madrid-spain-11-11-00d1460/ ithor-madrid-spain-11-11-00], DeckTech (Angel "Dj" San Jose, 15 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-15-ithor-madrid-spain-11-11-00d1460/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Generacion X, Madrid, Spain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Luis Alvarez]]
